sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 260. Magic damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: yourself. Increases Unison gauge gains by 2 for 60 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases the ATK and MATK of all allies by 40% for 60 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases the DEF and MDEF of all allies by 40% for 60 seconds.
[Additional Unison Effect] Increases the Unison gauge of all allies excluding yourself by 20.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 4000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 4000
Only [Origin] Misaka 10031 can be used as Unlocking Potential material
